cuts.head: over_shoulder
cuts.ofreeRecent: the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — standing; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — pours the batter from a mixing bowl of batter and a whisk into a baking tin; her bedroom — lying on her left side; the grand staircase of an old castle — standing; A small clockmaker's balcony with an open worktable overlooking slate roofs and a stone bell tower — She tests whether a tiny brass pendulum will keep time; an underwater palace hall behind great glass arches — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; A quiet upper room of a medieval inn — She slips out of her traveling shrug and hangs it over the chair before checking the knot on tomorrow's satchel; a monastery library of tall wooden shelves — kneeling on the ground; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — kneeling on the ground; a convention photo zone under ring lights — hugs a striped tub of popcorn against her side; a festival street of lanterns — carries a camera by its grip at her side; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — holds her keepsake up beside her face
